# Run book: Label an image without training

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/label-an-image.md) | [Spec](../specs/label-an-image.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)
- [Preconditions](#preconditions)
- [Verify](#verify)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Purpose

CLIP scores any label you type against an image, so new categories need no retraining, and the same model gives a vector for image search.

## Preconditions

- The first call downloads the CLIP model into the shared hub cache, so it needs internet once.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Label an image without training"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/ai/images`:

1. **Choose an image.** Pick a picture; the default labels are already filled in. Expect: The Classify and Embed buttons are enabled.
2. **Rank the labels.** Classify the image against the labels. Expect: A table lists the labels with probabilities, best first.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Classify is disabled | No image is chosen or fewer than two labels are given | Choose an image and enter at least two comma-separated labels |
| The first call fails | The model could not be downloaded | Provide internet access once, or copy the model files into the shared hub cache folder |

Related framework features: OoBDev.Vision.ClipVitB32 (zero-shot classifier); OoBDev.Onnx.ImageEmbeddings; OoBDev.Onnx.ImageEmbeddings.Skia.
